dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: People have been asking me lately if I know where to find Mr. Zhenyu from Liyue, but I've never heard of this person in my life.

dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: Is he some kind of superstar, even more well-known than the Qixing somehow?

dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: Ah, sorry for the wait, dear customer. Would you like some ores from Liyue?
